findings.title: Default `queued` timestamp is evaluated once at import time
findings.body: `queued: datetime = timezone.now()` is a dataclass default evaluated once when the module is imported, so every AssignmentSource gets the same stale timestamp rather than the time the assignment was queued. Use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)` instead.

findings.title: from_dict swallows missing-key and unexpected-key errors silently
findings.body: `from_dict` catches ValueError and TypeError and returns None. Payloads with extra keys or missing required keys (TypeError from the constructor) are treated as 'no source', so the loop-prevention check silently does not apply and outbound sync proceeds. Any schema drift between producer and consumer of the task payload re-opens the sync cycle without any log.

findings.title: to_dict serializes datetime, which is not JSON-safe for Celery kwargs
findings.body: `to_dict` uses `asdict`, which keeps `queued` as a datetime object. The result is passed as task kwargs through apply_async; depending on the serializer this fails or round-trips inconsistently. Serialize the timestamp to an ISO string, or drop it.

findings.title: where_should_sync calls should_sync without a sync source, so inbound-status paths are unaffected but the signature is inconsistent
findings.body: where_should_sync always calls `should_sync(key)` with no assignment source, so the new loop check never runs through this path. If it is ever used to gate outbound assignee sync, the same-integration check is silently bypassed. Either pass the source through or document why it is not needed.

findings.title: Outbound sync check only applied to user assignments; deassign path does not verify source propagation
findings.body: The assignment_source is passed to sync_group_assignee_outbound only in the user branch and in deassign. Inbound team assignments never sync outbound anyway, but the source is also dropped from the reassign path into remove_old_assignees, so no test covers the combined assign-then-deassign loop the PR is meant to break.

findings.title: Test name has typo and there is no test for a malformed-but-complete payload
findings.body: `test_from_dict_inalid_data` is misspelled. The tests also never cover a payload with a valid source_name/integration_id plus an extra key, which is the realistic drift case that from_dict silently drops to None.

findings.title: Base should_sync signature changed without updating all overrides
findings.body: IssueBasicIntegration.should_sync gained a sync_source parameter, but integrations overriding should_sync with the old one-argument signature will now raise TypeError when called with two arguments from sync_assignee_outbound task and where_should_sync paths. The change should be audited across all integrations.
